description: This file defines data models related to calendar events, leaves, and astrology details for the Malayalam calendar and astrology app.

classes.name: EventType
classes.description: Enumeration of different types of calendar events including holidays, leaves, and reminders.

classes.name: LeaveType
classes.description: Enumeration of different types of leaves such as casual, sick, and personal.

classes.name: CalendarEvent
classes.description: Data class representing a calendar event with attributes like id, title, description, start and end times, and event type.

classes.name: Leave
classes.description: Data class representing a leave with attributes like id, title, description, start and end dates, and leave type.

classes.name: AstrologyDetails
classes.description: Data class capturing astrology-related information for a specific date, including raasi, nakshatra, sunrise, sunset, and optional notes.
